column3: “Mind” renders head; summary renders head of words.
The second beast is introduced with appeared; the command to eat much flesh becomes gorge yourself.
“Arrogant” renders great; thrown specifies being given to the fire.
Removal of dominion is expressed passively.
The sheath is not explicit; mind renders head.
“More imposing” renders greater in appearance; words of arrogance renders great things.
“Pronounced judgment in favor of” renders judgment being given to the saints.
“Laws” replaces singular law; “the saints” identifies the pronoun they.
“Face turned pale” specifies changed brightness; “to myself” replaces in my heart.
